observation_relations.uncertainty_note: Short-baseline bearing (~100 m): azimuth is sensitive to the exact platform spot; tolerance kept wide.

rationale_i18n.zh-TW: 潮汐決定型（CL-COND-A7 慣例）：雙心石滬完整形態只在乾潮露出（漲潮淹沒滬石）。V2 評估層尚無潮汐資料源——誠實 propagate unknown（fail-closed → NOT_EVALUABLE）；legacy 管線已接 tide_state（low_exposure）。拍攝指南：出發前查澎湖潮汐表。
rationale_i18n.en: Tide-decided subject (CL-COND-A7 convention): the full double-heart fish-weir form shows only at low tide (the rising tide submerges the stones). The V2 evaluation layer has no tide data source - honest propagate unknown (fail-closed -> NOT_EVALUABLE); the legacy pipeline already carries tide_state (low_exposure). Shooting guide: check the Penghu tide table first.
rationale_i18n.ja: 潮位決定型（CL-COND-A7 慣例）：双心石滬の完全な形は干潮時だけ現れる（満潮で石が水没）。V2評価層に潮汐データソースがない — 誠実に propagate unknown（fail-closed → NOT_EVALUABLE）；legacy パイプラインは tide_state を実装済み（low_exposure）。撮影ガイド：出発前に澎湖の干潮表を確認。
